notes.title: Playtest v0.03
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed radio system breaking when any player detached their radio.
[*] Fixed keybinds not actually working or saving.
[*] Fixed a few issues with the radio being usable when it shouldn't've been.
[*] Fixed issue where when a player died and dropped their items, anything that wasn't currently in their hand was invisible.
[*] Fixed issue that when you were holding something and picked up a ragdoll, the thing would stay visible.
[*] Fixed issue where you could hear players igniting and burning across the world.
[*] Fixed issue where scrolling quickly while moving could leave the hold position of objects at weird spots.
[*] Reduced ethereal radiation levels.
[*] Removed bunnyhopping. Sorry. I don't want the default behavior of players to be required to be constantly jumping everywhere at all times.
[*] Removed the murderspheres at the back of the ship that were used for death and ragdoll debugging.[/list]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added player steam name indicator when hovering cursor over a player.
[*] Added indicator above player head to show their voice activity to better help identify players in a crowded room.
[*] Added number key support for inventory selection.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
Tons, but two major ones:
[list]
[*] You can join someone's game late, but the game will break for everyone. 
[*] Players seem to need to sit in the lobby for a few seconds before the host hits Start Game, or they don't get pulled into the game.
[*] Minor: The right side window has no collision. This is for debugging and I forget to turn collision back on.
[/list]
